## Overview

LRPMM01 is the DAG-sanctioned successor to the closed LRP66. Instead of a single
latent general ability `g`, it estimates **correlated domain factors** -
vocabulary, code, and grammar - from the standardised T1 skill indicators, then
regresses word-reading gain on those latent factors. It recovers the one output no
merged model produces: an explicit **factor-loadings / communality** table and a
partial **measurement-error correction** of the skill slopes.

_Measurement / triangulation, NOT causal._ This is a **measurement** model. Per the locked DAG's **ID-2**, every factor ->
gain slope is a **latent-ability-confounded adjusted association** - the factor
model improves the measurement match, it does **not** identify effects. The
corresponding randomised-arm result is the available-case modified ITT estimate in
`lrp-rli-itt-010`; the `gain_factors` randomised term is also outside this model.

_Fragility at n ~ 51._ A correlated-factor latent model at n ~ 51 is expected to be fragile and prior-dependent. If a reporting-tier fit passes, read it as triangulation against the `gain_factors` family and lead with its intervals. No magnitude or interval from a failed fit is a result.

## Model

**Measurement** (correlated unit-variance factors; loadings positive for
orientation). The indicators are standardised, so each free indicator's variance
budget is $\lambda_j^2 + \sigma_j^2 = 1$; since #383 that budget is structural —
the **communality** $c_j \sim \text{Beta}(2, 2)$ is the free parameter, with the
loading $\lambda_j = \sqrt{c_j}$ and residual $\sigma_j = \sqrt{1 - c_j}$
derived. The indicator-factor **correlation** is then
$\lambda_j / \sqrt{\lambda_j^2 + \sigma_j^2} = \lambda_j = \sqrt{\text{communality}}$
(the legacy free-pair geometry lives on in
[LRPMM101](../lrp-rli-mm-101/) as the sensitivity companion):

$$
\mathbf{f}_i \sim \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0}, \Omega), \quad \Omega \sim \text{LKJ}(\eta),
\qquad
Z_{ij} \sim \mathcal{N}\!\big(\lambda_j\, f_{i,\,d(j)},\ \sigma_j\big),
$$

**Structural** (Beta-Binomial reading-gain leg on the latent factors):

$$
\eta_i = \alpha + \gamma_{\text{own}}\,\text{logit}_*(W_{\mathrm{pre},i}, N)
        + \sum_d \beta_d\, f_{i,d}
        + \beta_{\text{blocks}}\,\text{blocks}_i + \beta_A\,A_{\text{std},i}.
$$

Domains (core set): **vocabulary** {R, E}, **code** {L, B}, **grammar** {F, T}.
Speech is unavailable as a standardised indicator here and is omitted; non-verbal
MA (`blocks`) enters the structural leg as an observed covariate, not a factor.
